comment: Differences between examples/providers/verdaccio/fake.js and a real Verdaccio that are known and kept, one entry each: the exact `id` the run prints, the Verdaccio majors it holds for, and the reason. The fake follows 6.10.6, the current stable release; what the 7.x line (7.0.0-next-7.31, a pre-release) does differently is listed here. A difference not listed fails the run; so does an entry that no longer matches anything.

allow.id: GET /@acme%2fwidget with unknown-token :: status fake=200 real=401
allow.reason: 7.x answers 401 to a token it cannot decrypt even for a package open to everyone; 6.10.6 takes it for an anonymous request (200).

allow.id: GET /@acme%2fwidget with unknown-token :: www-authenticate fake=null real="Bearer"
allow.reason: the 401 of 7.x for an undecryptable token carries `Bearer`.
the 401 of 7.x for an undecryptable token has an error body, not a packument.
a 7.x token create answers `cidr_whitelist` as well as `cidr`.
a 7.x packument has `maintainers`; 6.10.6 has none.
a 7.x 401 carries a bare `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` (final.ts); 6.10.6, which the fake follows, sends `Basic, Bearer`.
a 7.x token create answers `cidr_whitelist` as well as `cidr`.

allow.id: GET /-/whoami with read-token :: www-authenticate fake="Basic, Bearer" real="Bearer"
allow.reason: a 7.x 401 carries a bare `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` (final.ts); 6.10.6, which the fake follows, sends `Basic, Bearer`.

allow.reason: a 7.x 401 carries a bare `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` (final.ts); 6.10.6, which the fake follows, sends `Basic, Bearer`.

allow.id: GET /-/whoami with basic :: status fake=200 real=401
allow.reason: 7.x refuses Basic outside the login route (401); 6.10.6 accepts it on whoami (200).

allow.id: GET /-/whoami with basic :: www-authenticate fake=null real="Bearer"
allow.reason: the 401 for Basic on 7.x carries `Bearer`.

allow.id: GET /-/whoami with basic :: keys fake="username" real="error"
allow.reason: the 401 for Basic on 7.x has an error body, not a username.
a 7.x packument has `maintainers`; 6.10.6 has none.
